with reasons; they are never approximated by a simpler model.

interpolated from a sampled grid.

represented mesh) and volume integral (enclosed distributional source weights), computed
independently and compared.

ArrayStats.title: ArrayStats
ArrayStats.description:
Statistics computed in float64 before the float32 transport cast. For vectors they
describe the magnitude; for scalars the signed value.

BoundaryCondition.title: BoundaryCondition
BoundaryCondition.description:
Boundary condition attached to an object or to the domain boundary.

No Phase 1 solver evaluates boundary conditions; a scene that contains one is refused.

BoxShape.title: BoxShape
BoxShape.description: Width (local x), depth (local y), height (local z).

CircularLoopSource.title: CircularLoopSource
CircularLoopSource.description:
Ideal thin circular filament carrying a steady current (Phase 3A).

Carried by a ``ring`` primitive with role ``current_source``: centre = world position,
radius = ``radius_m`` times the in-plane world scale, normal n = normalised (c_x x c_y) of the
world matrix. Positive ``current_A`` circulates counter-clockwise about +n (right-hand rule:
B points along +n on the axis). Electrically neutral.

CurrentSourceInfo.title: CurrentSourceInfo
CurrentSourceInfo.description:
One ideal current filament (Phase 3A), in world coordinates, with its relation to every
plane-grid sampling (for drawing ⊙/⊗ crossings and projections; geometry only).

CylinderShape.title: CylinderShape
CylinderShape.description: Axis along local z; orient it with the surface rotation.

Domain.title: Domain
Domain.description:
Axis-aligned region of interest. It bounds sampling and visualization; the Phase 1
analytical model itself is unbounded (potential reference at infinity).

EquationView.title: EquationView
EquationView.description: An equation resolved against a model context: what the frontend displays.

EquipotentialRequest.title: EquipotentialRequest
EquipotentialRequest.description: Equipotential contour lines on a plane-grid sampling.

FieldLineRequest.title: FieldLineRequest
FieldLineRequest.description:
Ask for field lines. All density levels are computed at once so that changing the
displayed density is a visual-only operation.

``planar``: seeds on a circle in the plane of the referenced plane-grid sampling, around
every source lying in that plane. ``spherical``: seeds on a sphere around every source.

GroupPrimitive.title: GroupPrimitive
GroupPrimitive.description:
A container with no geometry of its own: its transform applies to its children.

``kind = "dipole"`` marks a pair of child point charges +q and −q (two real point charges at
a finite separation, not an ideal point dipole). The kind is an editing aid for the UI; the
physics always comes from the child charges themselves. Added in Phase 2A (additive: scenes
without groups are unchanged, schema_version stays 1).

InfiniteWireSource.title: InfiniteWireSource
InfiniteWireSource.description:
Ideal infinitely long straight filament carrying a steady current (Phase 3A).

Carried by a ``line`` primitive with role ``current_source``. A point on the axis is the
object's world position; the axis direction d is the normalised world image of local +z.
Positive ``current_A`` flows along +d. The primitive's length is display-only: the model is
infinite and has zero radius. The wire is electrically neutral (no electric field).

IsosurfaceRequest.title: IsosurfaceRequest
IsosurfaceRequest.description: Equipotential surfaces extracted on a lattice (the lattice samples are not transported).

LatticeSampling.title: LatticeSampling
LatticeSampling.description: Regular axis-aligned 3D lattice, inclusive of both ends. Shape (nz, ny, nx[, 3]).

LinePrimitive.title: LinePrimitive
LinePrimitive.description: Straight segment along local z, centred on the local origin.

MagneticContribution.title: MagneticContribution
MagneticContribution.description: Field of one current source at the probe point (Phase 3A).

MeshShape.title: MeshShape
MeshShape.description: A custom closed triangulated surface in local coordinates (engine-level for now).

MethodInfo.title: MethodInfo
MethodInfo.description:
How a derived product was obtained. Kept separate from the physical classification of the
field it was derived from: a numerically integrated line of an exact field is still a line
of an exact field.

ModelContext.title: ModelContext
ModelContext.description:
What physical model produced a result. The equation registry derives every equation's
applicability status from this, so statuses are computed rather than hard-coded.

PlaneGridSampling.title: PlaneGridSampling
PlaneGridSampling.description:
Regular grid on a planar cross-section through the 3D configuration.

Point (i, j) = center + (u_i) * u_dir + (v_j) * v_dir with u_i, v_j spanning
[-extent/2, +extent/2] inclusive. Arrays are stored row-major with shape (nv, nu[, 3]).

PlanePrimitive.title: PlanePrimitive
PlanePrimitive.description: Finite rectangle in the local xy plane (normal along local z).

PointChargeSource.title: PointChargeSource
PointChargeSource.description: Ideal point charge q located at the object's world position.

PointSourceInfo.title: PointSourceInfo
PointSourceInfo.description:
One ideal point charge as a distributional source (Phase 2B-1).

rho = sum_i q_i delta3(r - r_i), so div E = sum_i (q_i/eps0) delta3(r - r_i) and
div D = sum_i q_i delta3(r - r_i). The weights are exact; a delta source has no finite
pointwise value. Its distributional curl contribution is zero (there is no weight for it).

PresetVariant.title: PresetVariant
PresetVariant.description: An alternative configuration of the same preset (Phase 3A: preset 10).

ProbeContribution.title: ProbeContribution
ProbeContribution.description: Field of one source at the probe point (one term of the superposition sums).

ProbeDiagnostic.title: ProbeDiagnostic
ProbeDiagnostic.description:
Finite-difference estimate of an operator applied to the exact field. A numerical check
with an uncertainty, never the result: the exact value is given alongside.

ProbeDistributional.title: ProbeDistributional
ProbeDistributional.description: What holds at a point-charge position, where only distributions are meaningful.

ProbeMagnetic.title: ProbeMagnetic
ProbeMagnetic.description: Magnetic part of the probe (Phase 3A); present when the scene has current sources.

RingPrimitive.title: RingPrimitive
RingPrimitive.description: Circle in the local xy plane.

Role.title: Role
Role.description:
Physical role of an object. ``geometry_only`` objects are inert: they are drawn but are
explicitly excluded from the physical model (and reported as such in every result).

SurfaceDisplay.title: SurfaceDisplay
SurfaceDisplay.description: Visualization metadata. Ignored by the engine and excluded from every cache key.

Transform.title: Transform
Transform.description:
Local transform relative to the parent object (or to the world if there is no parent).

``rotation_euler_xyz_rad`` uses the rotation matrix R = Rx(a) @ Ry(b) @ Rz(c), which is the
Three.js default Euler order ``'XYZ'``. Composition: M = T @ R @ S.

ViewHint.title: ViewHint
ViewHint.description: View the preset opens with (display only; never part of the physics).
